comments.body: Looking at DashboardFilterProvider — the persist call writes to nimbus.filters.v2 without scoping. Drafting a key of nimbus.filters.v2:${workspaceId} and a migration for the unscoped blob.

content.text: Looking at DashboardFilterProvider — the persist call writes to nimbus.filters.v2 without scoping. Drafting a key of nimbus.filters.v2:${workspaceId} and a migration for the unscoped blob.

On the main dashboard, chip filters (status, assignee, component) are remembered while you stay in one workspace. After you change workspace from the top switcher, every chip snaps back to the product default set even though the prior selection was still valid for that board.

Expected: each workspace keeps its own chip selection for the browser session, or at least restores the last filters stored under that workspace id. Actual: the chip bar always reloads from DEFAULT_FILTERS after a workspace change, discarding custom combinations of three or more chips.

Suspect the filter store keys only on userId and never includes workspaceId, so the hydrate path after workspace.switched overwrites local state with the global default map. Users who juggle two or three workspaces re-apply the same chips dozens of times per day and lose the filtered board context mid-review.
